1.web: Surely God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart.
1.asv: Surely God is good to Israel, Evento such as are pure in heart.

2.web: But as for me, my feet were almost gone. My steps had nearly slipped.
2.asv: But as for me, my feet were almost gone; My steps had well nigh slipped.

3.web: For I was envious of the arrogant, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
3.asv: For I was envious at the arrogant, When I saw the prosperity of the wicked.

4.web: For there are no struggles in their death, but their strength is firm.
4.asv: For there are no pangs in their death; But their strength is firm.

5.web: They are free from burdens of men, neither are they plagued like other men.
5.asv: They are not in trouble asothermen; Neither are they plagued likeothermen.

6.web: Therefore pride is like a chain around their neck. Violence covers them like a garment.
6.asv: Therefore pride is as a chain about their neck; Violence covereth them as a garment.

7.web: Their eyes bulge with fat. Their minds pass the limits of conceit.
7.asv: Their eyes stand out with fatness: They have more than heart could wish.

8.web: They scoff and speak with malice. In arrogance, they threaten oppression.
8.asv: They scoff, and in wickedness utter oppression: They speak loftily.

9.web: They have set their mouth in the heavens. Their tongue walks through the earth.
9.asv: They have set their mouth in the heavens, And their tongue walketh through the earth.

10.web: Therefore their people return to them, and they drink up waters of abundance.
10.asv: Therefore his people return hither: And waters of a fullcupare drained by them.

11.web: They say, “How does God know? Is there knowledge in the Most High?”
11.asv: And they say, How doth God know? And is there knowledge in the Most High?

12.web: Behold, these are the wicked. Being always at ease, they increase in riches.
12.asv: Behold, these are the wicked; And, being alway at ease, they increase in riches.

13.web: Surely in vain I have cleansed my heart, and washed my hands in innocence,
13.asv: Surely in vain have I cleansed my heart, And washed my hands in innocency;

14.web: For all day long have I been plagued, and punished every morning.
14.asv: For all the day long have I been plagued, And chastened every morning.

15.web: If I had said, “I will speak thus”; behold, I would have betrayed the generation of your children.
15.asv: If I had said, I will speak thus; Behold, I had dealt treacherously with the generation of thy children.

16.web: When I tried to understand this, it was too painful for me;
16.asv: When I thought how I might know this, It was too painful for me;

17.web: Until I entered God’s sanctuary, and considered their latter end.
17.asv: Until I went into the sanctuary of God, And considered their latter end.

18.web: Surely you set them in slippery places. You throw them down to destruction.
18.asv: Surely thou settest them in slippery places: Thou castest them down to destruction.

19.web: How they are suddenly destroyed! They are completely swept away with terrors.
19.asv: How are they become a desolation in a moment! They are utterly consumed with terrors.

20.web: As a dream when one wakes up, so, Lord, when you awake, you will despise their fantasies.
20.asv: As a dream when one awaketh, So, O Lord, when thou awakest, thou wilt despise their image.

21.web: For my soul was grieved. I was embittered in my heart.
21.asv: For my soul was grieved, And I was pricked in my heart:

22.web: I was so senseless and ignorant. I was a brute beast before you.
22.asv: So brutish was I, and ignorant; I wasasa beast before thee.

23.web: Nevertheless, I am continually with you. You have held my right hand.
23.asv: Nevertheless I am continually with thee: Thou hast holden my right hand.

24.web: You will guide me with your counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.
24.asv: Thou wilt guide me with thy counsel, And afterward receive me to glory.

25.web: Whom do I have in heaven? There is no one on earth whom I desire besides you.
25.asv: Whom have I in heavenbut thee? And there is none upon earth that I desire besides thee.

26.web: My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
26.asv: My flesh and my heart faileth; ButGod is the strength of my heart and my portion for ever.

27.web: For, behold, those who are far from you shall perish. You have destroyed all those who are unfaithful to you.
27.asv: For, lo, they that are far from thee shall perish: Thou hast destroyed all them that play the harlot, departing from thee.

28.web: But it is good for me to come close to God. I have made the Lord Yahweh my refuge, that I may tell of all your works.
28.asv: But it is good for me to draw near unto God: I have made the Lord Jehovah my refuge, That I may tell of all thy works.
